selectionProcess: Written Exam → Interview / DV as applicable

howToApply:

shortDescription: UPCISB UP Co-operative Bank various post exam has been postponed. Candidates should check official portal for revised date and admit card.
content:
The examination for various posts under UP Cooperative Bank / UPCISB recruitment has been postponed as per official communication.

Candidates who applied should regularly visit the official board / bank recruitment website for the revised exam date, new admit card link and instructions. Ignore any cancelled schedule dates.
